question: According to Census of India 2011, in how many States / Union Territories was the female literacy rate recorded more than 90%?
solution:
The correct answer is **__One__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• According to the Census of India 2011, the female literacy rate in one state/union territories was recorded above 90%.
 
• The one region with female literacy rates above 90% was Kerala.
 
• Kerala had the highest female literacy rate at 92.07%.
 
• Mizoram and Lakshadweep followed closely with female literacy rates of 89.27% and 88.25%, respectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Literacy Rate in India:**

 
 
• The overall literacy rate in India as per the Census of 2011 was 74.04%.
 
• Male literacy stood at 82.14%, while female literacy was recorded at 65.46%.
 
 
 
• **Kerala's Education System:**
 
 
• Kerala is known for its high literacy rates and strong emphasis on education.
 
• The state has a robust network of schools and educational institutions.
 
 
 
• **Mizoram's Literacy:**
 
 
• Mizoram also ranks high in literacy due to effective educational policies.
 
• The state's literacy rate is among the highest in the Northeastern region of India.
 
 
 
• **Female Literacy Initiatives:**
 
 
• Various government initiatives have been undertaken to improve female literacy rates, including the Beti Bachao Beti Padhao scheme.
 
• Efforts have been made to enhance educational infrastructure and access to education for girls.
